data.title: UPDATE - Woodward Appoints Paxton McVoy as Chief Information Officer
data.description:
FORT COLLINS, Colo., Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Woodward (NASDAQ: WWD), a global leader in aerospace and industrial energy control solutions, today announced the appointment of Paxton McVoy as Executive Vice President and Chief Information Officer (CIO), effective Oct. 19, 2026. He will join the company's Executive Leadership Team, reporting directly to Chief Executive Officer Chip Blankenship.

In this newly created role, McVoy will lead Woodward's global information technology organization and set the direction for the company’s digital strategy, including enterprise resource planning (ERP), data and analytics, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and technology-enabled business transformation.

McVoy joins Woodward from Veralto, where he was Senior Vice President and Chief Information Officer. Following Veralto's separation from Danaher, he led the new public company's global technology strategy and operations and helped build Veralto's technology organization after the company became independent. His responsibilities included enterprise technology, cybersecurity, data and AI, infrastructure, procurement, and oversight of the ERP portfolio across 13 operating companies. Earlier in his career, he held senior IT leadership roles at Medtronic, including Vice President and CIO for the company's Surgical Innovations business. He also previously was instrumental in leading Medtronic's transition from Oracle to SAP. 

"Paxton has a proven history of using technology to improve business performance and leading digital transformation across complex global organizations like ours. In this role he will help us to set the direction for how information technology will support our long-term growth strategy," said Chip Blankenship, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Woodward. "His experience shaping enterprise technology strategy, advancing AI capabilities, and building strong teams will help us strengthen Woodward's digital foundation in line with our efforts to serve customers and create shareholder value."

"I am looking forward to joining Woodward at an important point in the company's growth," said McVoy. "Woodward's focus on innovation, operational excellence, and creating value for customers and shareholders creates a real opportunity to use technology as a strategic advantage. I look forward to working with the leadership team and Woodward members around the world to help ensure the success of the company's digital transformation."

McVoy holds a Bachelor of Arts in Business from Otterbein University and an MBA from The Ohio State University.

About Woodward, Inc.

Woodward is the global leader in the design, manufacture, and service of energy conversion and control solutions for the aerospace and industrial equipment markets. Our purpose is to design and deliver energy control solutions our partners count on to power a clean future. Our innovative fluid, combustion, electrical, propulsion, and motion control systems perform in some of the world’s harshest environments. Woodward is a global company headquartered in Fort Collins, Colorado, USA. Visit our website at www.woodward.com.

data.title: Bloom Energy Supports Central Texas First Responders Ahead of Florida-Texas Matchup
data.description:
Bloom Energy Supports Central Texas First Responders Ahead of Florida-Texas Matchup

Bloom’s $10,000 donation will help fund critical equipment, training and resources for first responders across Central Texas.

Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) continued its season-long partnership with ESPN Radio’s College Football Campus Tour this week in Austin, Texas.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261016766768/en/

Ahead of the Florida-Texas matchup, Bloom visited Austin Fire Department Station #3 and presented a $10,000 donation to the Central Texas Public Safety Commission, a nonprofit organization that supports police, fire and EMS departments across Central Texas.

For more than 25 years, the Central Texas Public Safety Commission has worked with first responders and community partners to identify and fund critical needs, including equipment, training, wellness programs and community initiatives that strengthen public safety.

“Every community’s resilience ultimately depends on people,” said Natalie Sunderland, Chief Marketing Officer at Bloom Energy. “The firefighters, EMS personnel and first responders supported by the Central Texas Public Safety Commission are the people communities turn to on their hardest days. We are proud to support an organization that helps ensure they have the resources they need to serve Central Texas.”

“The Central Texas Public Safety Commission provides critical support for equipment, training and other needs that fall outside our normal operating budget,” said Austin Interim Fire Chief Tom Vocke. “Support from organizations like Bloom Energy helps supplement city resources and ensures our firefighters have what they need to stay safe and ready to respond.”

Austin Fire Department Station #3 opened in 1957 and serves the University of Texas and surrounding Central Austin neighborhoods. The station reopened in October 2023 following a renovation that rebuilt its apparatus bays and added dedicated spaces designed to improve firefighter health and safety while preserving the station’s original design.

Bloom will also be on the University of Texas campus Saturday during pregame festivities, where fans can take part in an interactive experience and learn more about Bloom's work, providing clean, reliable power for essential services and critical infrastructure across the country.

Upcoming Confirmed 2026 Tour Stops

  • October 17 – Austin, Texas | Florida at Texas
  • November 7 – Oxford, Mississippi | Georgia at Ole Miss
  • November 14 – Baton Rouge, Louisiana | Texas at LSU
  • November 21 – Lincoln, Nebraska | Ohio State at Nebraska
  • November 28 – Nashville, Tennessee | Tennessee at Vanderbilt

About Bloom Energy

Bloom Energy empowers enterprises to meet soaring energy demands and responsibly take charge of their power needs. The company’s fuel cell systems provide ultra-reliable, clean and highly scalable onsite electricity for Fortune 500 customers around the world, including data centers, semiconductor manufacturing, large utilities and other commercial and industrial sectors, as well as mission-critical organizations in local communities, such as hospitals, college campuses and retailers. Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Bloom Energy employs more than 2,000 people worldwide and manufactures its systems in the United States. For more information, visit BloomEnergy.com.

data.title: Apollo Commercial Real Estate Finance, Inc. Provides Update on Liquidation Activities
data.description:
NEW YORK, Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Apollo Commercial Real Estate Finance, Inc. (the “Company”) (NYSE: ARI) today provided an update on its ongoing liquidation activities, including updates regarding the anticipated timing of delisting from the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) and the establishment of a liquidating trust for purposes of completing the wind-down process and dissolution of the Company in accordance with the Plan of Complete Liquidation and Dissolution (the “Plan”).

The Company has provided notice to the NYSE of its intention to voluntarily delist its shares of common stock (the “Shares”) from the NYSE. The Company expects to file a Form 25, or Notification of Removal from Listing, with the Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) and the NYSE relating to the delisting of the Shares on or about October 27, 2026. The Company also expects that the last day of trading on the NYSE will be November 6, 2026. After delisting from the NYSE, the Company will transfer all of its remaining assets and liabilities to a statutory trust formed under the laws of the State of Maryland (the “Liquidating Trust”), deregister with the SEC, which the Company expects to occur on November 9, 2026, and terminate its existence by voluntary dissolution. The purpose of the Liquidating Trust is to wind up the Company’s affairs and liquidate the Company’s remaining assets, to preserve the value of such assets in connection with their orderly liquidation and, after satisfying or providing for the Company’s remaining liabilities, to distribute such assets or the proceeds thereof to the holders of the beneficial interests of the Liquidating Trust (the “Beneficial Interests”). After the transfer of the Company’s assets and liabilities to the Liquidating Trust, the Company intends to distribute the Beneficial Interests to the stockholders of the Company on a one-for-one basis.

Following the transfer of the Company’s assets and liabilities to the Liquidating Trust, subject to certain limited exceptions including transfer by will, intestate succession or operation of law, the Beneficial Interests will not be transferable, nor will holders of Beneficial Interests have authority or power to sell or in any other manner dispose of their Beneficial Interests. The Beneficial Interests will not trade on the NYSE or any other exchange. The rights of holders of Beneficial Interests in the Liquidating Trust will not be represented by any form of certificate or other instrument.

Based on guidance previously provided by the SEC in similar circumstances, assuming the Company terminates its existence as described above, the Company anticipates that the Liquidating Trust will be required to file only annual reports on Form 10-K (using the SEC file number of the Company) containing unaudited financial statements, as well as current reports on Form 8-K (also filed using the SEC file number of the Company).

The Company expects ACREFI Management, LLC, or one of its affiliates, to be retained as manager of the Liquidating Trust to oversee the day-to-day operations of the Liquidating Trust. The actual amount and timing of payment of any additional liquidating distribution(s) would be made by the board of trustees of the Liquidating Trust in its sole discretion.

Material U.S. Federal Income Tax Consequences
Information regarding the expected U.S. federal income tax consequences of any additional liquidating distributions, as well as the Plan, are summarized in the Company’s definitive proxy statement, filed with the SEC on August 24, 2026, for the special meeting of shareholders held on September 29, 2026, which is available free of charge through the website maintained by the SEC at http://www.sec.gov. However, the tax treatment described may vary depending on each shareholder’s particular situation.

About Apollo Commercial Real Estate Finance, Inc.
On September 29, 2026, the Company’s stockholders approved the liquidation and dissolution of the Company in accordance with the Plan. Prior to stockholder approval of the Plan, the Company operated as a real estate investment trust that primarily originated, acquired, invested in and managed performing commercial first mortgage loans, subordinate financings and other commercial real estate-related debt investments. The Company plans to sell all assets in an orderly fashion and return net proceeds from asset sales and cash on hand to stockholders, subject to payment of the Company’s liabilities and obligations and the creation of associated reserves. The Company is externally managed and advised by ACREFI Management, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and an indirect subsidiary of Apollo Global Management, Inc., a high-growth, global alternative asset manager with approximately $1.05 trillion of assets under management as of June 30, 2026.

Additional information can be found on the Company’s website at www.apollocref.com.

data.title: LexinFintech Holdings Ltd. Announces Receipt of Nasdaq Notification Regarding Minimum Bid Price
data.description:
SHENZHEN, China, Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LexinFintech Holdings Ltd. (“Lexin” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: LX), a leading technology-empowered personal financial service enabler in China, today announced that it received a written notice (the “Notice”) from the Listing Qualifications Department of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (“Nasdaq”) on October 14, 2026 indicating that the Company is not in compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under the Nasdaq Listing Rules (the “Listing Rules”). Based on the closing bid price of the Company’s listed securities from September 1, 2026 to October 13, 2026, the Company has not met the minimum bid price requirement set forth in Listing Rule 5450(a)(1) during that period. The Notice is only a notification of deficiency and has no immediate effect on the listing of the Company’s American Depositary Shares (“ADS”). The Company’s ADSs will continue to trade on the Nasdaq Global Select Market at this time. The Company’s receipt of the Notice does not impact the Company’s business, operations or reporting requirements with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. 

The Notice states that under Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A), the Company is provided with a period of 180 calendar days, or until April 12, 2027, to regain compliance with the Listing Rules, for which the closing bid price of the Company’s ADSs must meet or exceed $1.00 per ADS for at least ten consecutive business days unless Nasdaq exercises its discretion to extend this ten-day period. In the event the Company does not regain compliance by April 12, 2027, the Company may be eligible for an additional period to regain compliance or may face delisting.

The Company is evaluating options to regain compliance with Nasdaq’s continued listing requirements, including a potential adjustment of the ratio of its ADSs to Class A ordinary shares, and intends to take appropriate measures to timely regain compliance.

The Notice is a standard procedural communication under Nasdaq's listing rules and does not immediately impact the Company's business operations or SEC reporting status. While the Company will use reasonable efforts to regain compliance, there can be no assurance that the Company will ultimately be able to do so. In the event the Company is unable to regain compliance within the applicable period, Nasdaq will initiate delisting proceedings, and the Company will evaluate all available alternatives at that time.

About LexinFintech Holdings Ltd.

We are a leading credit technology-empowered personal financial service enabler. Our mission is to use technology and risk management expertise to make financing more accessible for young generation consumers. We strive to achieve this mission by connecting consumers with financial institutions, where we facilitate through a unique model that includes online and offline channels, installment consumption platform, big data and AI driven credit risk management capabilities, as well as smart user and loan management systems. Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz Encourages Gildan Activewear Inc. (GIL) Shareholders to Inquire About Securities Fraud Class Action

The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz announces that a class action lawsuit has been filed on behalf of shareholders who purchased or otherwise acquired Gildan Activewear Inc. (“Gildan” or the “Company”) (NYSE: GIL) securities between February 19, 2025 and June 15, 2026, inclusive (the “Class Period”). Gildan investors have until December 14, 2026 to file a lead plaintiff motion.

IF YOU SUFFERED A LOSS ON YOUR GILDAN ACTIVEWEAR INC. (GIL) INVESTMENTS, CLICK HERE TO SUBMIT A CLAIM TO POTENTIALLY RECOVER YOUR LOSSES IN THE ONGOING SECURITIES FRAUD LAWSUIT.

You can also contact the Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz to discuss your legal rights by email at info@frankcruzlaw.com, by telephone at (310) 914-5007, or visit our website at www.frankcruzlaw.com.

What Happened?

On June 16, 2026, Jehoshaphat Research published a short report alleging that Gildan had been “stuffing” distributors and customers with excess product beyond underlying end-user demand and had pulled forward approximately $500 million of revenue from upcoming 2026 quarters.

On this news, Gildan’s stock price fell $11.63 per share, or 18.7%, to close at $50.34 per share on June 16, 2026, thereby injuring investors.

What Is the Lawsuit About?

The complaint filed in this class action alleges that throughout the Class Period, Defendants made materially false and/or misleading statements, as well as failed to disclose material adverse facts about the Company’s business, operations, and prospects. Specifically, Defendants failed to disclose to investors that: (1) Gildan did not have adequate internal controls; (2) Gildan used channel stuffing to create an appearance of revenue; and (3) as a result, Defendants’ positive statements about the Company’s business, operations, and prospects were materially misleading and/or lacked a reasonable basis at all relevant times.

data.title: Trident Reports First Half 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
data.description:
SINGAPORE, Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd (“Trident” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: TDTH), a Singapore-headquartered digital infrastructure and technology holding company building sovereign-scale platforms across emerging markets, today announced its unaudited financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026.

First Half 2026 Financial Highlights

  • Total revenues increased more than tenfold to US$384,741, compared to US$36,612 for the six months ended June 30, 2025.
  • Gross profit increased more than twentyfold to US$356,879, compared to US$17,643 for the prior-year period.
  • Gross margin expanded to approximately 93%, compared to approximately 48% for the prior-year period, reflecting the high-margin, platform-driven nature of the Company’s revenue model.
  • Net loss was US$12,727,298, compared to US$11,271,548 for the six months ended June 30, 2025, as the Company invested in platform deployment, market entry and corporate infrastructure.
  • Non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA(1) was a loss of US$4,545,711, compared to a loss of US$4,379,209 for the six months ended June 30, 2025 — essentially flat year-over-year despite the expansion in operating footprint.
 (1)The Company uses non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA to understand and evaluate its core operating performance. Non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA is calculated as net loss excluding interest expense, net, income tax (benefit) expense, depreciation and amortization expenses, share-based compensation expense and gains on fair value change.
    

Management Commentary

Soon Huat Lim, Trident’s Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, commented: “The first half of 2026 was about building. The second half is about delivering. Through TDTH Africa, our Ghana joint venture is onboarding micro, small and medium-sized enterprises onto Sikaflow and supporting the Ghana Revenue Authority’s digital tax program. Through our AI & Intelligent Systems Group, we are taking TDTHAI to market and building our IRMA Engine Asia joint venture across Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Africa. Through our Cybersecurity Group, we are bringing Memcyco’s real-time fraud protection to banks across Asia-Pacific. And through our Tridentity Infrastructure Group, we are advancing opportunities to expand digital identity across Africa. The approximately US$23 million of new equity we raised in September, gives us the balance sheet to execute. Our commitment to shareholders is simple: clear milestones, delivered and reported publicly.”

Recent Capital and Business Developments

  • Founder converts US$8 million of debt to equity. At the Company’s extraordinary general meeting on July 8, 2026, shareholders approved the conversion of US$8,000,000 of debt owed to Mr. Soon Huat Lim, the Company’s Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, into Class B ordinary shares, together with a share consolidation and the Company’s Third Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association.

  • IRMA Engine Investment and IRMA Engine Asia joint venture executed. On June 30, 2026, the Company entered into an exchange agreement with Digital Innovations Group, Inc. (“DIG”) to acquire 990,000 shares of DIG common stock in exchange for the issuance of Class B Ordinary Shares of the Company with an aggregate value of US$2,000,000. The transaction had its initial closing on July 17, 2026. In August 2026, the Company executed a 50/50 joint venture with DIG to deploy the IRMA AI Engine across Asia, the Middle East and Africa, markets representing approximately 9.4 million businesses.

  • Total of US$23.0 million private placement and registered direct offering. On September 8, 2026 and September 29, 2026, the Company closed a private placement of 20,000,000 Class B ordinary shares to certain non-U.S. investors at US$0.40 per share for aggregate gross proceeds of US$8.0 million, a registered direct offering of 30,000,000 Class B ordinary shares at US$0.50 per share for aggregate gross proceeds of US$15,000,000 before offering expenses.

About Trident

Trident is a Singapore-headquartered digital infrastructure and technology holding company focused on building and operating sovereign-scale technology platforms across emerging markets. The Company’s strategy centers on entering high-growth economies through trusted digital identity infrastructure and expanding across adjacent verticals spanning government technology, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, digital commerce, agritech, and transaction-driven services. Trident’s active initiatives include national digital identity mandates, MSME digital tax formalization platforms, enterprise AI deployment, and cybersecurity solutions across Africa and the Asia-Pacific region. With active operations and strategic initiatives in Ghana and Asia-Pacific markets, Trident is positioning itself to capitalize on one of the world’s largest long-term opportunities in digital transformation infrastructure, enterprise AI deployment, and sovereign-scale technology modernization.

data.title: FMC Corporation Investigation Notice: Levi & Korsinsky Notifies Investors of Pending Investigation Into FMC Corporation (FMC)
data.description:
FMC Corporation Investigation Notice: Levi & Korsinsky Notifies Investors of Pending Investigation Into FMC Corporation (FMC)

FMC Corporation Investigation Notice: Levi & Korsinsky Notifies Investors of Pending Investigation Into FMC Corporation (FMC)

PR Newswire

NEW YORK, Oct. 16, 2026

FMC Corporation sold roughly $403 million of newly issued shares in September 2026 and previously announced a $1.2 billion senior secured notes offering before cutting its Q3 2026 revenue outlook from $840 million to $900 million down to $65 million to $125 million. The investigation focuses on the Company's SEC-reported offering disclosures.

NEW YORK, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FMC Corporation (NYSE: FMC) shares fell between 31% and 46% after the Company cut its third-quarter 2026 revenue outlook to $65 million to $125 million, down from $840 million to $900 million. That reset came weeks after FMC sold approximately $403 million of newly issued stock at $13.30 per share. If you lost money on FMC stock, you are encouraged to submit your FMC loss details now. You may also contact Joseph E. Levi, Esq. via email at jlevi@levikorsinsky.com or by telephone at (212) 363-7500.

FMC's own SEC filings record the capital raises. A Form 8-K filed May 19, 2026 relates to the Company's secured notes, and FMC marketed approximately $1.95 billion of secured notes across May and June 2026. A Form 8-K filed July 1, 2026 reports the sale of newly issued FMC shares to Tessenderlo Group at $13.30 per share, worth roughly $403 million, the transaction closed on September 23, 2026. The investigation examines the Company's SEC-reported offering disclosures in light of its subsequent Q3 2026 revenue guidance reduction.

The revised outlook calls for a third-quarter Adjusted EBITDA loss of $510 million to $565 million, compared with the previously projected Adjusted EBITDA profit of $120 million to $140 million. Levi & Korsinsky is investigating potential securities law violations tied to the disclosures FMC provided to investors and note purchasers while these offerings were underway.

FMC shareholders who suffered losses can request a free review of their FMC losses or call Joseph E. Levi, Esq. at (212) 363-7500.

WHY LEVI & KORSINSKY -- Ranked in ISS Securities Class Action Services' Top 50 Report for seven consecutive years, Levi & Korsinsky, LLP is a nationally recognized leader in shareholder rights litigation. Frequently Asked Questions About the FMC Investigation

Q: Who is eligible to participate in the FMC investigation?A: Investors who purchased FMC stock or securities and suffered financial losses may be eligible. Eligibility is based on purchase date and documented losses -- not on whether you still hold the shares.

Q: How much did FMC stock drop?A: Shares fell approximately 31% to 46% after the Company issued a Form 8-K revising its third-quarter 2026 revenue guidance to $65 million to $125 million, from $840 million to $900 million. The same update moved its Adjusted EBITDA outlook to a loss of $510 million to $565 million. Investors who purchased shares at allegedly inflated prices and suffered losses may be eligible to seek compensation.

Q: Which statements are being investigated as potentially misleading?A: The investigation concerns whether FMC Corporation made materially false or misleading statements about its business conditions and outlook.  The focus is on disclosures tied to its May–June 2026 secured notes offerings and its June 30, 2026 agreement to sell newly issued shares to Tessenderlo, which was reported in an SEC Form 8-K filed July 1, 2026. When the Company disclosed its Q3 2026 guidance revision, the stock price declined sharply.

Q: What do FMC investors need to do right now?A: Investors may gather brokerage records showing purchase dates, share quantities, and prices paid. Submit your information for a no-cost, no-obligation evaluation of your potential recovery. No immediate action is required to remain eligible to participate in the investigation.

Q: What documents do I need to participate?A: Brokerage statements or trade confirmations showing purchase dates, share quantities, prices paid, and any subsequent sale dates and prices.

Q: What if I already sold my FMC shares -- can I still recover losses?A: Yes. Eligibility is based on when you purchased, not whether you still hold the shares. Investors who bought FMC and sold at a loss may still participate in the investigation.

data.title: Gauzy Announces $7 Million Private Placement Led by Management to Fund Court-Approved Settlement
data.description:
TEL AVIV, Israel, Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Gauzy Ltd. (Nasdaq: GAUZ) ("Gauzy" or the "Company"), a global leader in light and vision control technology, today announced that it has entered into a securities purchase agreement (the "Purchase Agreement") with a group of accredited investors led by Eyal Peso, the Company's Chief Executive Officer (collectively, the “Purchasers”), for a private investment in public equity ("PIPE") resulting in $7 million in aggregate gross proceeds (the "Offering"). Pursuant to the Purchase Agreement, the Company agreed to issue and sell 2,383,279 ordinary shares, no par value (“Ordinary Shares”), to the Purchasers at a purchase price of $2.9371 per share. In addition, in accordance with the terms of the Company’s court-approved debt settlement (the “Settlement”), 953,311 Ordinary Shares will be issued to the trustees appointed under the Settlement, Adv. Ehud Gindes and Adv. (CPA) Simion Keidar (the “Settlement Trustees”).

The Offering is intended to ensure that the Settlement is financed from day one. As previously announced, the Tel Aviv-Jaffa District Court granted final approval of the Settlement, effective September 8, 2026, under Israel's Insolvency and Economic Rehabilitation Law, 5778-2018, in Insolvency Proceeding No. 51175-03-26. The Settlement resolves approximately $61 million of the Company's pre-petition liabilities.

“This investment reflects my personal conviction, and that of our management team, in Gauzy’s technology, our customers and our long-term growth strategy,” said Eyal Peso, Chief Executive Officer of Gauzy. “With the court-approved Settlement now fully financed from day one, we have resolved our legacy liabilities and can turn our full attention to executing on our backlog across the Architecture, Automotive, Aviation and Rail markets and delivering value for our customers, employees and shareholders.”

The Offering closed on October 15, 2026. Of the gross proceeds, $1,638,000 will be held by the Settlement Trustees and refunded to the applicable Purchasers, and the corresponding Ordinary Shares will be cancelled, if the Lyon Commercial Court does not approve the French continuation plan for the Company’s subsidiary, Safety Tech SAS, on or before November 13, 2026.

About Gauzy

Gauzy Ltd. is a fully integrated light and vision control technology company specializing in the research, development, manufacturing, and marketing of innovative solutions that enhance safety, sustainability, comfort, and user experiences across multiple industries. Headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel, Gauzy operates through subsidiaries and entities in Germany, France, the United States, Canada, China, Singapore, and the United Arab Emirates. The company serves leading brands in the aeronautics, automotive, and architecture sectors across more than 60 countries through direct fulfillment and a global network of certified distribution partners. Gauzy’s ordinary shares trade on the Nasdaq Stock Market under the ticker symbol GAUZ. For more information, visit www.gauzy.com.

data.title: ICE review: Canola Weakens on Seasonal Harvest Pressure
data.description:
WINNIPEG, Manitoba--The ICE Futures canola market was weaker on Friday, hitting fresh seven-week lows as steady farmer selling and bearish technical signals weighed on prices.

--November canola was down by C$2.90 at C$798.80 per ton, with the move below C$800 per ton bearish from a chart standpoint.

--Losses in the Chicago soy complex and European rapeseed contributed to the softer tone in canola, although Malaysian palm oil was firmer to end the week.

--Seasonal harvest pressure remained a bearish influence, as warm and dry forecasts across most of the Prairies this weekend should allow farmers to make good progress bringing in the last of the crop.

--Farmers delivered 620,100 tons of canola into the commercial pipeline during the week ended Oct. 11, reported the Canadian Grain Commission. While that was down by 19% from the previous week, crop-year-to-date deliveries at 4.45 million tons are 28% ahead of last year's pace.

--Weekly Canadian canola exports at 158,300 tons were down from 248,400 tons the previous week. Crop-year-to-date exports are up 44% on the year at 1.38 million tons through 10 weeks.

--There were 113,995 contracts traded on Friday, which compares with Thursday when 107,034 contracts changed hands. Spreading accounted for 81,200 of the contracts traded.
